transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora. I'm a clinical conversational agent, and I'm here to help you with any questions you might have about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions for me?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous activities like lifting heavy objects for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, great to know. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the clarification. I'm feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, is not normal and may need further assessment. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense, thank you. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for your vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all my questions for now. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you!

verdict.label: pass
